input.title: String: Lapsed 7 days headline to "Your Squad Needs You Back"
input.description:
String change for the Lapsed 7 days message (DES-317, a Go for beta).

The strings are hard-coded in `Assets/Scripts/Notifications/NotificationManager.cs` (match3d), so this needs a code change and a new store build.

- Current client headline (`WeeklyReminderTitle`): "They’ve Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱"
- New headline (Leonard's call in #zombie-art, Sep 29): "Your Squad Needs You Back"
- Body stays as it is.

Heads-up: the same `WeeklyReminderTitle` string also goes out on days 14, 21 and 28, because the client schedules this message every 7 days for 4 weeks. Those sends will pick up the new headline too.

When it ships, Vincent needs to see it arrive again on store builds for both iOS and Android.

input.title: Zombie Match beta phone messages - team note (Oct 1)
input.bodyText:
Zombie Match beta phone messages: where we stand (Oct 1)
Calls sheet: "Zombie Match beta phone messages - calls (Oct 1)", in this folder. Every call follows Leonard's Beta message rule.

1. Retention we're judged on: Sep 15 install cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%

2. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day
NotificationManager reschedules every time the game goes to the background. Day 0 is the day the game was last closed.
- Day 1: Lapsed 1 day, "The Horde Is Growing… 🧟‍♂️"
- Day 7: Lapsed 7 days, "They've Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱". This changes to "Your Squad Needs You Back" (DES-346).
- Day 14: the same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 21: the same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 28: the same Lapsed 7 days message again (last lapsed send)
- Nothing goes out on day 3 or day 30. Those asks are Holds (DES-342, DES-343). Lapsed 14 days (DES-344) is a Drop because day 14 is already covered.
Players only get any of these after our own permission ask (after the tutorial, level 20) or the settings toggle. The Unity popup at launch on iOS doesn't switch anything on.

3. Messages the client already schedules that are still a Hold, and why
- Finish first mission (DES-318). Test 4: it's scheduled for players below the tutorial-end level, but our permission ask only runs after the tutorial, so none of the players it's written for can receive it. Vincent's pass was with notifications switched on from settings, and that doesn't count.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320). Test 5: it fires 7/14/21/28 days after the day the game was closed, not on the weekly reset day, so it lands on the wrong day for most players.

4. Totals: 32 messages (14 sheet rows + 18 asks)
- Go 4: Lives recharged, Lapsed 1 day, Lapsed 7 days (new headline, DES-346), Plague Race. These are on the push notifications card checklist for Vincent.
- Hold 22: 2 already scheduled (above). 15 the client doesn't schedule yet (test 3). 5 that need a server send (test 2).
- Drop 6: Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever, Axe Arena, Comeback gift (not in beta), Lapsed 14 days (covered by Lapsed 7 days).
The sheet's six "Ready" rows don't hold up: Finish first mission and Weekly Leaderboard reset are Holds.
